# Get it right the first time

Operate within a specialized CAD environment to create high fidelity solar designs in a fraction of the time.

[Schedule Demo](https://aurorasolar.com/public-demo/)

Design Mode

## Maximize accuracy _and_ speed

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Ruler.png)

### Create designs without the truck roll

Create highly accurate solar designs without having to visit the site, saving time and money during the quoting process.

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Sunpath.png)

### Speed up design without sacrificing accuracy

Aurora’s remote site assessment, LIDAR-based shade analysis, and AI-assisted 3D modeling give you pixel-perfect design almost instantly.

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Refresh.png)

### Streamline your entire design workflow

Create, edit, and simulate your system design all from the same place with our in-app CAD engine.

![A screenshot of a 3d mapping software interface demonstrating the rendering of a residential area with trees, using lidar data.](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/aur_dm_body_b1@2x.png)

## LIDAR-based shade analysis

Forget about on-site shade measurements, Aurora’s irradiance engine provides shade analysis values that are statistically equivalent.

![Top-down solar panel layout on a building with greenery graphics](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/aur_dm_body_b2@2x.png)

## Automatic system design

Automatically fill roof surfaces with pre-strung modules, inverters, and BOS components.

![Solar panel design report with satellite imagery, solar data, and financial analysis.](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/aur_dm_body_b3@2x.png)

## NEC validation reports

Review your electrical configuration through Aurora’s validation reports and check your system for NEC compliance.

## The future of solar starts now

## Testimonials

> We’ve had 4 cases where customers didn’t agree with the measurements on the Aurora design that we presented virtually. We decided to go out to the site and measure the house by hand with the homeowner, and in every instance, Aurora was correct. They were actually wrong about the measurements of their own home. The accuracy of the Aurora software, combined with our willingness to put it to the test on-site, helped close the deal each time!

> It's all about customer expectations. It's a great experience for everyone: the rep, the company, the customer. It makes the whole process easier when you get it right from the start

> We can now create a design for a home in a predetermined amount of time. When it becomes more of a push-of-a-button as opposed to an order, it definitely helps our efficiency. When that pipeline of jobs becomes exponentially bigger, it becomes more and more critical.

> The final product that we’re presenting to the homeowner is just so much more professional. The 3D models, sunpath, LIDAR, and other tools are very effective in a sale.
